brief:
Israeli settlers launched a wave of attacks across the occupied West Bank and East Jerusalem on Tuesday, the Palestine News Network reported. The assaults targeted Palestinian olive harvesters during the harvest season, destroyed vehicles by setting them on fire, and damaged schoolchildren's property, according to the account.

The incidents marked an intensification of settler violence across multiple locations in the territory during a period when Palestinians undertake their annual olive harvest.

title: Israeli settlers escalate attacks on West Bank Palestinians, targeting harvesters and property
